alt: The first page of papers/1706.03762v7.pdf (Attention Is All You Need) goes to gpt-4o, which returns a typed PaperMetadataModel with the title, each author's name, email and affiliation, and the abstract; the record lands in three Postgres tables: paper_metadata (with num_pages 15), an author_papers index where Jeff Dean links to two papers, and metadata_embeddings for the title and abstract chunks; adding a PDF extracts only that paper.
